versus

----
Ms Swapna Kode a/w Mr Manoj Kondekar, for the Applicants.
Mr Pankaj Deokar, APP , for Respondent / State.
----
Coram: R.N. Laddha, J.
  Date: 18 July 2025
P.C.:
. The learned Counsel for the applicants submits that the
applicants have filed anticipatory bail applications before  the
Sessions Court, being Anticipatory Bail Applications No.32 80
of 2025 and 3279 of 2025 on 12 May 2025.  He submits th at
despite the matter being listed on as many as six occasion s, the
said applications have not been decided by the Session s Court
till date.  The learned Counsel, therefore, prays for app ropriate
directions to be issued to the Sessions Court to consider a nd
decide the said anticipatory bail applications at the earliest.  
2. In  view  of  the  above,  the  learned  Sessions  Court  is
directed to consider and decide the applicants’ anticipatory bail
applications  expeditiously  and  as far  as possible  within  one
